title: 第155章 绝对默契
slug: 综艺大导演从齐聚初代跑男开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“咔嗒！”

201室的门锁弹开，陈鹤推门而出。

他的表情是满脸的嫌弃。

陈鹤走过来摇着头道：“你知道我刚才在里面有多紧张吗？我真怕你又选错了！”

邓朝却非常自信道：“有什么好紧张的，我的实力你还不知道吗？简单，嗖EZ！”

陈鹤深吸一口气，看在镜头的份上，忍住了没有爆粗口。

他转头看向镜头，扯出一个职业微笑：“观众朋友们，你们看到了吗？普信男就是他这样的！”

邓朝立刻反驳：“什么叫普信男？我明明就很聪明！”

陈鹤翻了个白眼，不想说话了。

另一边，208室的门也

黄垒走出来，西装笔挺，气质儒雅，跟孙洪雷形成了鲜明对比。

孙洪雷的西装外套，已经不知道什么时候被他披在肩上。

衬衫袖子卷到小臂，领带松松垮垮地挂在脖子上。

整个人看起来就像是个西装暴徒。

“洪雷啊！”黄垒走到孙洪雷面前，语重心长地说，“你告诉我，你是怎么想到西瓜的？”

孙洪雷理直气壮：“因为我想吃西瓜。”

黄垒：“……”

他沉默了三秒钟，然后转头对着镜头，微笑着说：“观众朋友们，有时候正确答案并不需要逻辑，只需要看你想不想吃。”

孙洪雷嘿嘿一笑，拍了拍黄垒的肩膀：“垒垒啊，管那么多干嘛呢，咱们赢了不就行了！走走走，快去下一个房间救兄弟！”

双方此刻终于开始拼速度了。

下一道门前，邓朝、陈鹤两个人站定。

邓朝擦了擦额头上并不存在的汗，长出一口气：“第一个门差点失败，这默契挑战不简单啊。”

陈鹤面无表情地看着他：“哪里不简单了？不简单是因为什么，你心里没点数吗？”

邓朝假装没听见，转头看向走廊另一头。

孙洪雷和黄垒也走到了门口。

“我们要快点了！”邓朝眯了眯眼。

陈鹤点头：“先看看房间里是谁吧。”

“是我！郑凯！”

郑凯的声音传来，陈鹤心里了然。

吴凡的声音响起：“这一关你们双方的问题各不相同，默契挑战现在开始！”

“请听题！”

“如果你们要结伴去旅行，只能带一样东西，有以下四个选项：A.地图；B.指南针；C.手机；D.收音机，请做出选择！”

“倒计时，五、四……”

这次邓朝没有急着抢答。

他非常自觉地往旁边退了一步，把位置让给了陈鹤。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Click!"

The door lock of Room 201 popped open, and Chen He pushed the door open and walked out.

His expression was full of disgust.

Chen He walked over and shook his head and said, "Do you know how nervous I was in there just now? I'm really afraid that you made the wrong choice again!"

Deng Chao said very confidently: "What are you so nervous about? Don't you know my strength yet? It's simple, Swish EZ!"

Chen He took a deep breath and refrained from swearing for the sake of the camera.

He turned to look at the camera and put on a professional smile: "Viewers, have you seen it? That's what Pu Xinnan is like!"

Deng Chao immediately retorted: "What is Puxinnan? I'm obviously very smart!"

Chen He rolled his eyes and didn't want to talk anymore.

On the other side, the door of Room 208 is also

Huang Lei walked out with a neat suit and elegant temperament, which was in sharp contrast to Sun Honglei.

Sun Honglei's suit jacket was draped over his shoulders at some point.

His shirt sleeves were rolled up to his forearms and his tie hung loosely around his neck.

He looked like a thug in a suit.

"Hong Lei!" Huang Lei walked up to Sun Honglei and said earnestly, "Tell me, how did you come up with the idea of watermelon?"

Sun Honglei said confidently: "Because I want to eat watermelon."

Huang Lei: "..."

He was silent for three seconds, then turned to face the camera and said with a smile: "Viewers, sometimes the right answer does not require logic, it just depends on whether you want to eat it or not."

Sun Honglei chuckled and patted Huang Lei on the shoulder: "Lele Lei, why do you care so much? It's enough if we win! Let's go, let's go to the next room to save our brothers!"

The two sides finally began to compete for speed at this moment.

In front of the next door, Deng Chao and Chen He stood still.

Deng Chao wiped the non-existent sweat on his forehead and let out a sigh of relief: "I almost failed at the first gate. This tacit understanding challenge is not easy."

Chen He looked at him expressionlessly: "Where is it not simple? Why is it not simple? Don't you have a clear idea in your mind?"

Deng Chao pretended not to hear and turned to look at the other end of the corridor.

Sun Honglei and Huang Lei also walked to the door.

"We have to hurry up!" Deng Chao narrowed his eyes.

Chen He nodded: "Let's see who is in the room first."

"It's me! Zheng Kai!"

Zheng Kai's voice came, and Chen He understood.

Wu Fan's voice sounded: "The problems you both face in this level are different. The tacit challenge begins now!"

"Please listen to the question!"

"If you are going to travel together and you can only bring one thing, you have the following four options: A. Map; B. Compass; C. Mobile phone; D. Radio, please make a choice!"

"Countdown, five, four..."

This time Deng Chao was not in a hurry to answer.

He very consciously took a step aside and gave up his position to Chen He.
